notes.title: Adventurers Gambit: November Update & Enhancements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665853/55596ce2f0cda6b9384253ac108340c48fb996a7.png[/img]
[b]November Changelog for [i]Adventurers Gambit[/i][/b]

We are excited to share that our development team is actively working on improving [b]Adventurers Gambit[/b]. This month, we've made significant progress, and we're thrilled to give you a glimpse of what's new and what's been enhanced. Here are the details:

[b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new dungeons, enhancing the variety of available challenges.
[*]Implemented pre-cast ability effects and updated weapon rebalance.
[*]Introduced new attacks and improved attack animations for several characters.
[*]Added multiple new attack sound effects for ghosts, zombies, and skeletons.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665853/ff3d7cbfde77e5c462d1159e8c6256944ad9f324.png[/img]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed multiple issues with dungeon exits, including the exit window and portal inconsistencies.
[*]Corrected client-host synchronization for weapons visibility.
[*]Fixed tutorial issues related to missing doors, and interaction with objects.
[*]Fixed chest opening issues and other loot-related bugs.
[*]Resolved an issue with player extraction causing a crash in multiplayer mode.
[/list]

[b]Visual and Audio Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved skeleton, ghost, and mummy animations.
[*]Added new zombie and skeleton sound effects, including footsteps and attack sounds.
[*]Enhanced 3D sounds with correct positioning and fixed related issues.
[*]Added particle effects and improved texture quality for weapons during attacks.
[*]Fixed visual effects for invisibility, fire beam, and black hole abilities.
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reworked health and damage ratios for specific enemies.
[*]Adjusted difficulty levels and added new balancing to weapon stats.
[*]Fixed issues with spell cooldowns and adjusted the attack speed of several abilities.
[*]Removed unused dungeons, updated minimap colliders, and adjusted door interaction hitboxes.
[*]Added new difficulty levels, which can now be selected from the menu.
[/list]

[b]Interface and User Experience:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated tooltips and descriptions for better clarity, including the addition of health and stat descriptions.
[*]Improved player extraction notifications and portal feedback during multiplayer sessions.
[*]Added functionality to save settings more reliably across sessions.
[*]Tooltip logs cleared and fixed to show the correct width for all items.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665853/168be21415057141b440c85589954db68aacf1b4.png[/img]
[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added underwear for characters for visual consistency.
[/list]

notes.title: Gameplay Update: Enhancements and New Features
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[*] Added game tutorial.
[*] Different types of equipment items were added to the loot system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665853/9df25df79eb201889b086aad314414bccd03a2a6.png[/img]
[*] Added crouched movement. Players can now crouch and move while crouched.
[*] Added 2 types of traps into rooms: ground trap with spikes and movable weapon trap.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665853/6f6d3e8c2a54dafe3091ca49ce8156a20ca81f3e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665853/382af9ec21fb6fe2f91df0ad72f91fb9596a233d.png[/img]
[*] Added more healing shrines into rooms.
[*] Healing shrines got some rebalance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665853/b5489745db44eba6ced9bbeeb87c98f0c1aa5ca2.png[/img]
[*] Creatures AI has some improvements.
[*] Creature damage scaling was reduced from 10% per minute to 5%.
[*] Stamina recovery rate reduced from 50 to 15 per second.

[b]Design[/b]
[*] Graphics settings got huge improvements: light and shadow are more realistic, added global illumination and all textures became more realistic.
[*] Added controller support.
[*] Hair has received animation adjustments, making it move more realistically.
[*] Added character eyes blinking.
[*] Creature animations got adjustments.
[*] Fog removed from rooms.
[*] Valkyrie's Heart ability visual effect improved.
[*] The minimap scale increased.
[*] Portals and chests are now shown on the minimap.
[*] The loading screen now displays immediately.
[*] Added Steam Search Lobby Auto Refresh.
[*] Added a close button to Settings UI.
[*] Added Boss Health UI.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the game to crash after 2 players are trying to join.
[*] Fixed an issue causing traps sometimes to crash the game if they kill the player.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevents "You're dead" window from displaying after the second (third, fourth, etc.) game sessions which prevents from continuing to play the game.
[*] Fixed critical issues that prevent the bank from working properly.
[*] Fixed a bug causing sound settings to not apply on all non-music sounds.
[*] Fixed an issue causing Settings UI to not open after the first game session.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the player not to lose his items after death.
[*] Fixed an issue causing area of effects abilities such as Fire Beam/Black Hole to cast on walls and ceilings.
[*] Fixed an issue causing Move Speed stat doesn't work properly.
[*] Fixed an issue causing slash effects to be seeable only for the caster, not to everyone.
[*] Fixed a bug causing pink texture to appear when a character is doing anything.
[*] Fixed a bug where the item would be destroyed when picked up if the inventory was full.
[*] Fixed an issue causing a character to become fully naked after death.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented players from dying after falling into the hole in the green smoke room.
[*] Fixed an issue causing lava pools to not do any damage.
[*] Fixed an issue causing exiting to the main menu or to the desktop not to destroy player's items.
[*] Fixed a bug causing XP text in the player stats menu to not update.
[*] Fixed an issue causing XP bar to show the wrong values.

notes.title: Epic Update: New Adventures Await
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to bring you an exciting update packed with new features and enhancements that will elevate your gaming experience to new heights. Dive into the details below to discover what’s in store:
[list]
[*] [b]Revamped Room Designs[/b]: 
Every room has been completely redesigned, offering greater visual variety and more tactical depth. Players can now enjoy a richer, more immersive experience with improved layout flow and meticulous attention to detail, enhancing both exploration and combat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665853/623cfd4d193d5cf5468bc51a55098c6f05c9e14c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665853/50e9ad410d9e1ceb9ff2a5784c74fd26dba0be42.png[/img]
[*] [b]PvP Arena Introduced[/b]: 
Step into the Arena, where champions can engage in fierce PvP combat. Test your skills against other players, where only the strongest will emerge victorious.
[*] [b]Added Portals from Dungeons[/b]:
We’ve introduced Exit Portals in dungeons, giving players a strategic choice: escape with their loot or take a risk to delve deeper for more rewards. But beware—if you overstay and die, you’ll lose everything you’ve collected!
[*] [b]New Creature Type – Undead[/b]: 
Beware the restless dead! A new threat emerges with the undead, relentless creatures with twisted powers that will challenge even the most seasoned adventurers. Prepare for more intense battles as these monsters won’t go down easily.
[*] [b]New Boss – Lich[/b]: 
Enter the lair of the Lich, a terrifying new boss with two distinct and deadly abilities that will test your skills and strategy. Only the brave will survive the encounter, but the rewards will be worth the risk.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665853/bd22f9a4c0676a26ad659f56229314e1532b9aa0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665853/c1d2eb58a1625265919c6f3117a727f67821bb3f.png[/img]

[*]Removed creatures’ health bars. To raise the tension and immersion in every battle, we've removed the health bars from all creatures.
[*]Creatures' base health, damage and move speed were rebalanced
[*]Creature attack animation time increased from 0,5 to 1 second. We made this change to give players more options to complete the dungeon without taking damage from creatures.
[*]Scaling creature power. As the game progresses, creatures become stronger. Every minute, creatures receive a 10% boost to both health and damage, ensuring that the mid-to-late game remains challenging. This mechanic aims to keep the dungeon experience tense while maintaining the player’s feeling of increasing power, typical of RPG progression. We’ll be closely monitoring this feature to ensure enemies don’t become too overwhelming.
[*]Target focus feature added
[*]Added new ability – Shadow Bolt. Unleash the power of darkness with the newly added Shadow Bolt ability. This high-impact spell strikes from the shadows, delivering a devastating blow to your enemies.
[*]Rebalanced abilities
[/list]

[b]Design[/b]
[list]
[*]Main menu design overhaul.
[*]Updated the settings menu UI.
[*]Added new customization options to settings.
[*]Implemented a game lobby interface for joining games.
[*]Added credits screen.
[*]Overhauled the abilities selection interface.
[*]Players no longer lose control while in the Equipment or Inventory interfaces.
[*]Improved the visual effect of the Energy Shield ability.
[*]Added a smart AI NPC that players can interact with via voice commands.
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue preventing the start of a new session after the first without restarting the game.
[*]Fixed a bug where destroying or throwing out items on the client would crash the game.
[*]Fixed a bug causing creatures to loop the death animation.
[*]Fixed a bug preventing creatures from becoming aggroed when hit from behind in melee.
[*]Fixed an issue where ability descriptions were not displaying.
[*]Fixed incorrect cooldown display.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Crystal Nova circle effect would not disappear.
[*]Resolved a bug where characters moved sluggishly after performing any action.
[*]Fixed a bug causing stamina to drain while hardcasting.
[*]Addressed an issue where sprint would remain active even when the character wasn’t moving.
[*]Fixed a bug causing a jump to interrupt stamina generation
[/list]

notes.title: Unleash Dungeons & Dangers: Your Offline Adventure Companion! (Nightly Update)
notes.content:
Say farewell to internet dependence with our local LLM AI model. Dive into the depths of dungeons and face perilous dangers with a character-rich ChatGPT 3.5 like AI at your side. No dedicated server needed, just your trusty PC bringing your adventures to life. Watch as your AI companion, embodying the spirit of an orc within the game universe, crafts responses that match the thrill of your journey. With the option for pure CPU power or the added speed of RTX, your quests are bound to be more exhilarating than ever!

[previewyoutube=9tBchXV26pM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Playing through server possibility locked until next testing period. Single player or host coop mode available.[/h3]
